title: refactor(objectql)!: retire the PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY ledger — the tenant-audit mute is decided by the schema, and the [tenant-audit] warning names both readings
body:
Fixes #25201

Part of the ADR-0131 18.x line (owed scope of #15212, D13). Takes #25203's item 4 (the stale "tracked as #14570" docblocks).

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **The per-table ledger is retired.** `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts` is deleted, along with its six exports from `@objectstack/objectql`: `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY`, `classifyPlatformObjectTenancy`, `isPlatformObjectOutOfTenantAuditScope`, `tenantScopedPlatformObjects`, `PlatformObjectTenancy` and `PlatformObjectTenancyEntry`.
- **The tenant-audit mute is decided by the schema.** In `Engine.buildDriverOptions`, an elevated write is auto-muted (`bypassTenantAudit: true`) only when the object has no tenant column (`resolveTenantFieldName(schema) === null`, i.e. `tenancy.enabled: false`, `systemFields.tenant: false` or no tenant field) or is federated. No name and no list decides it. That is ADR-0131 D9's "column ⇒ in scope", now applied to the audit as well.
- **The `[tenant-audit]` warning** (`SqlDriver.auditMissingTenant`) no longer tells every unscoped write to "Pass tenantId". It names both readings, because the driver cannot tell them apart:
  - a write that belongs to one organization should run in that organization's context;
  - a write that crosses organizations on purpose (a platform admin the organization wall exempts, or a system job over every organization) needs no fix, and the caller declares it with `bypassTenantAudit: true`.

  The line's prefix and metadata are unchanged.
- **Docblocks:** `system-write-organization.ts`, `approval-service.ts`, `business-unit-graph.ts` and the B3 test comment now describe the post-ADR-0131 write paths. Seed replay (C1) and elevated inserts (D9) stamp the organization, so a NULL member row is pre-18.0 residue or a lean composition. They no longer cite the ledger, nor #14570 as the tracking card (that card is no longer open).
- **The census is repurposed, not removed.** `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs` already executed the schema predicate (`resolveTenantFieldName` on the registered schema) and never read the ledger. Two things move:
  - its `HEADER` pointer now targets `resolveTenantFieldName`'s docblock in `system-write-organization.ts`;
  - the artefact's comment says `reach: in` is the whole of the engine's tenancy scope.

  The artefact is regenerated (the comment only; no row moved: 84 / 41 / 43). `lint.yml`'s step runs it unchanged and green, so no governed-path change is needed. Its stated readers: that gate, and `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts`.

## Measured before the change (base `9c431bad`)

- **Readers of `isPlatformObjectOutOfTenantAuditScope`:** one behavioural reader, `engine.ts`'s `isTenantAuditInScope`. It only decided `opts.bypassTenantAudit`, which the SQL driver reads in `auditMissingTenant` to skip a WARN. Diagnostics only. The system-insert rule had no ledger reader left (stage 8b and #24667).
- **Importers of the six exports outside `@objectstack/objectql`:**
  - `scripts/audits/14096-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.mjs`, a dated one-off audit that imports `dist`. Nothing runs it (no `package.json` script, no workflow, no gate roster). It now refuses loudly at import, which its own docblock prescribes for a missing ledger.
  - No package imports them.
  - Because they are published names, removing them is still declared a narrowing.

## Acceptance notes

`git grep PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY`, outside CHANGELOGs, still finds files this PR may not or should not touch:
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md:403` and `docs/adr/0131…:878` (governed);
- `docs/audits/2026-09-tenancy-ledger-namespace-regexp-census.md` (a dated audit record);
- `scripts/audits/14096-…mjs` (above).

Also outside this card's surface: `packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts:76` (and its generated reference page) still cites the deleted file's path.

## Proof (head `aaa6ef6a`)

- **CI:** every required context is green: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (all six shards), `Build Core` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, plus `Check Changeset`.
- **Pins, with ablations** (the commit was in place first; each restore is `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`, and the tree was clean afterwards):
  - **The mute is decided by the schema.** `tenancy-by-object-classification.test.ts` passes 28/28. Ablation: I re-added a per-table exemption for `sys_audit_entry` in `buildDriverOptions`. Exactly 2 pins went red: "sys_audit_entry … is NOT auto-muted" and "the SAME driver options — the name decides nothing". The other 26 stayed green, among them every write pin (derive, refusals, the stamped `tenantId`) for `sys_audit_entry` itself. So a per-table entry changes no write; it changes only the mute.
  - **The ledger's exports are gone.** A tombstone pin checks that the public API has no `PlatformObject*` name.
  - **The warning's new text.** `sql-driver-tenant-audit-posture.test.ts` passes 12/12. Ablation: restoring base `sql-driver.ts` turns exactly the new pin red (1 failed, 11 passed).
- **Package suites and typecheck, all exit 0:**
  - objectql: 8643 passed;
  - driver-sql: 3749 passed, 212 skipped (live-dialect cells);
  - plugin-approvals: 1213;
  - plugin-sharing: 1200;
  - service-messaging: 628;
  - service-storage: 1130.
- **`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`:** 100 commands, each run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran`: "100 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 99 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". Two exits are non-zero, both shallow-clone prerequisites:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: exit 3, prerequisite not met;
  - `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90`: exit 2, refuses on a shallow clone.

  The census gate is green in both modes: 84 objects, 41 in reach, 43 out, every exclusion explained.
- **`check-governed-merges --branch`:** NOT governed. +263/−501 over 14 files.
- **R1 (fresh boot):** `pnpm dev -- --fresh` gave health 200. The seeded admin signs in (200) and reads `showcase_account` (200, 14 rows). There are 0 `[tenant-audit]` lines, since `single` does not audit.
- **R4 (walled `os serve`):**
  - **Setup:** `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` with a fresh SQLite file, `OS_SECRET_KEY`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only` and `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`. The showcase declares no `@objectstack/organizations`, so for this run only I declared it locally and linked the workspace package. Both are reverted, and the tree is clean.
  - **Result:** health 200, no refusal. The owner signs up (200), signs in (200) and reads `sys_user` (200).
  - **What the audit printed:** 43 `[tenant-audit]` lines over boot and sign-up, every one with the new text, across 22 objects. 18 are `showcase_*` app objects, which were audited before too. The 4 platform objects now audited because the ledger's mute is gone are `sys_activity`, `sys_business_unit`, `sys_member` and `sys_user_permission_set`.
- **Upgrade harness:** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` passes 15/15. That is 8 tests on the 18.0 fixture (ceremony, boot, data) plus 7 on the fixture-18.0.0 leg (boots HEAD with no refusal, no destructive drift, rows intact, the D1 advisory).

## Observation, not filed

On R4 several of those lines are **creates**. They must carry `organization_id` on the row: under a wall an organization-less system insert is refused (D9), and a row that names its organization reaches the driver with no `tenantId` (pinned in `tenancy-by-object-classification.test.ts`). Examples are `create` on `sys_business_unit` and `bulkCreate` on `showcase_account`. For an insert the row's own column is the scope, so these lines are noise. That was already true for application objects before this PR; it now covers those 4 platform objects as well. A follow-up could have the driver skip the audit on an insert whose row carries its tenant field. That is the 8c-1 design space, outside this card.
